series.name: Lynx Smart BMS — Status LED red-flash fault codes
series.notes: The Lynx Smart BMS has only TWO LEDs (Bluetooth + Status). Faults are identified by COUNTING red flashes of the Status LED in a 4-second window - there is no printed number. This is a self-contained series because a technician standing at the panel has no other display. Some counts (e.g. 2, 3, 4) appear only in the manual's appendix table; others (6, 7, 8, 9) appear in the Troubleshooting chapter. Codes 11 and 13 are NOT used by this manual - 12 and 14 are the next values after 10.

title.en: Status LED red 1x per 4 s - warning active
title.ur: Status LED laal 1 baar / 4 s - warning chal rahi hai

meaning.en: A warning is active. The BMS is still running; open VictronConnect or the GX device to read which warning it is.
meaning.ur: Aik warning chal rahi hai. BMS abhi chal raha hai; VictronConnect ya GX device kholein taake pata chale kaunsi warning hai.

causes.en: Any of the BMS warning conditions (low cell voltage, high current, high BMS temperature, bad contactor, load about to disconnect, low SoC, VE.CAN or Distributor comms lost)
causes.ur: BMS ki koi bhi warning shart (low cell voltage, high current, high BMS temperature, kharab contactor, load disconnect hone wala hai, low SoC, VE.CAN ya Distributor comms lost)

causes.en: Warning has only just been raised, so the underlying cause may not yet be measured
causes.ur: Warning abhi abhi aayi hai, is liye asal wajah abhi tak measure bhi nahi hui ho sakti

solutions.en: Open VictronConnect or the GX device and read the actual warning code (see the Lynx warning series).
solutions.ur: VictronConnect ya GX device kholein aur asal warning code parhein (Lynx warning series dekhein).

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage and load current to see if a low-voltage or high-current warning is the cause.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage aur load current nikaalein taake pata chale ke low voltage ya high current warning ki wajah hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 2x - battery BMS comms error
title.ur: Status LED laal 2 baar - battery BMS comms error

meaning.en: The BMS cannot talk to the batteries over the battery BMS cable loop.
meaning.ur: BMS battery BMS cable loop ke zariye batteries se baat nahi kar sakta.

causes.en: Battery BMS cable not connected or not seated in the BMS
causes.ur: Battery BMS cable BMS mein nahi jury ya poori tarah lagi nahi

causes.en: Open circuit in the battery BMS cable loop
causes.ur: Battery BMS cable loop mein khulna (open circuit)

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then reseat every battery BMS connector, working along the chain from the BMS outwards.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir BMS se bahar ki taraf chain mein har battery BMS connector dobara lagaayein.

solutions.en: Measure continuity of the BMS cable loop end to end; the loop must be closed.
solutions.ur: BMS cable loop ki continuity sifar se sifar nikaalein; loop band hona chahiye.

solutions.en: Inspect for water ingress or crushed cable, then re-test.
solutions.ur: Paani ke ghusaav ya dabba hua cable dekhein, phir dobara test karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 3x - cell volt/temp out of range
title.ur: Status LED laal 3 baar - cell voltage/temp range se bahar

meaning.en: A high or low cell voltage, or a high or low temperature, has been detected inside the battery pack.
meaning.ur: Battery pack ke andar kisi cell ka voltage ya temperature high ya low detect hua hai.

causes.en: Cell undervoltage - bank discharged
causes.ur: Cell undervoltage - bank khatam ho gaya

causes.en: Cell overvoltage - overcharging or unbalanced cells
causes.ur: Cell overvoltage - zyada charge ya cells unbalanced

causes.en: Pack temperature above or below the safe limit
causes.ur: Pack temperature safe limit se upar ya neeche

solutions.en: Measure total bank voltage and compare it to the state of charge in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: Bank ka total voltage nikaal kar VictronConnect ke state of charge se compare karein.

solutions.en: If low: recharge the bank on a known-good charger and watch the cells re-balance.
solutions.ur: Agar kam hai: bank ko aik ache charger se charge karein aur cells ko re-balance hote dekhein.

solutions.en: If high: disconnect all other chargers and loads, then check the BMS balancing readings per cell.
solutions.ur: Agar zyada hai: baqi chargers aur loads disconnect karein, phir har cell ka BMS balancing reading check karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 4x - BMS too hot
title.ur: Status LED laal 4 baar - BMS garam hai

meaning.ur: BMS khud garam ho gaya hai.

causes.en: Ambient temperature too high around the BMS
causes.ur: BMS ke aar paas ambient temperature bohat zyada hai

causes.en: BMS cooling fans not running
causes.ur: BMS ke cooling fans nahi chal rahe

solutions.en: Check the ambient temperature where the Lynx is installed.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke Lynx jahan lagi hai wahan ambient temperature kya hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the BMS fans actually spin; the manual says contact the dealer if they are not running.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke BMS fans asal mein chalti hain; manual ke mutabiq agar nahi chalti to dealer se rabta karein.

solutions.en: Reduce the load and improve airflow; re-test after cooling.
solutions.ur: Load kam karein aur hawa ka rausta behtar karein; thanda hote hi dobara test karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 5x - pre-charge timed out
title.ur: Status LED laal 5 baar - pre-charge timeout

meaning.en: The BMS could not finish pre-charging the DC loads in time.
meaning.ur: BMS DC loads ko pre-charge khatam nahi kar paya.

causes.en: Load capacitance too high or load resistance too low (under about 20 Ohm)
causes.ur: Load ki capacitance bohat zyada ya resistance bohat kam (taqreeb 20 Ohm se neeche)

causes.en: Too many loads or chargers left connected during pre-charge
causes.ur: Pre-charge ke dauran bohat zyada loads ya chargers jury hain

solutions.en: Isolate DC and switch off all loads and chargers.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein aur tamam loads aur chargers band karein.

solutions.en: Reconnect loads one at a time to find the one causing the pre-charge failure.
solutions.ur: Loads ek ek kar ke dobara jurayein taake woh dhoondein jo pre-charge rok raha hai.

solutions.en: Measure the load resistance; it should be above the manual's 20 Ohm threshold.
solutions.ur: Load resistance nikaalein; ye manual ke 20 Ohm se upar hona chahiye.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 6x - pre-charge current too high
title.ur: Status LED laal 6 baar - pre-charge current zyada hai

meaning.en: The energy or current drawn during pre-charging exceeded the allowed value.
meaning.ur: Pre-charge ke dauran kharcha ya current matloon se zyada ho gaya.

causes.en: A load with very low resistance connected to the load output
causes.ur: Load output par bohat kam resistance wala load jury hai

causes.en: Pre-charged energy limit exceeded by the combined load
causes.ur: Mil kar pre-charge kiya gaya energy matloon se zyada ho gaya

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then disconnect or remove some DC loads.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir kuch DC loads hata dein ya disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Rule out short circuits in the load wiring with an insulation tester.
solutions.ur: Insulation tester se load wiring ke shorts check karke hatayein.

solutions.en: Reconnect in stages and watch the pre-charge current each time.
solutions.ur: Stage by stage dobara jurayein aur har baar pre-charge current dekhein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 7x - wrong system voltage
title.ur: Status LED laal 7 baar - system voltage ghalat hai

meaning.en: The measured battery voltage sits outside the threshold for the configured system voltage. Thresholds are 9-15 V for 12 V, 16-30 V for 24 V, and 32-60 V for 48 V.
meaning.ur: Measured battery voltage configured system voltage ki threshold se bahar hai. Thresholds: 12 V ke liye 9-15 V, 24 V ke liye 16-30 V, aur 48 V ke liye 32-60 V.

causes.en: BMS configured for the wrong system voltage (12/24/48 V)
causes.ur: BMS ghalat system voltage (12/24/48 V) ke liye configure hai

causes.en: Actual battery voltage does not match the configuration
causes.ur: Asal battery voltage configuration se match nahi karti

solutions.en: Measure the actual bank voltage with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se asal bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare it to the manual's threshold table and confirm the system voltage setting in VictronConnect.
solutions.ur: Manual ki threshold table se compare karein aur VictronConnect mein system voltage setting confirm karein.

solutions.en: Correct the battery settings to match the real bank, then re-test.
solutions.ur: Battery settings ko asal bank ke mutabiq theek karein, phir dobara test karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 8x - current too high
title.ur: Status LED laal 8 baar - current bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: Sustained current exceeded the BMS rating - the manual cites more than 600 A (1200 A for the 1000 A model) for more than 5 minutes.
meaning.ur: Mustaqbil current BMS rating se zyada raha - manual ke mutabiq 600 A (1000 A model ke liye 1200 A) se zyada, 5 minute se ooper.

causes.en: Load current above the BMS continuous rating
causes.ur: Load current BMS ki continuous rating se zyada hai

causes.en: High discharge current or a high charge current sustained too long
causes.ur: High discharge current ya bohat der tak chalay gaya high charge current

solutions.en: Measure the current with a clamp meter on the main busbar.
solutions.ur: Main busbar par clamp meter se current nikaalein.

solutions.en: Reduce the connected load until current is below the rating the manual states for your model.
solutions.ur: Load itna kam karein jab tak current aapke model ki rating se neeche na aaye.

solutions.en: If the load is already small, check for a shorted appliance or a stuck inverter/charger drawing DC.
solutions.ur: Agar load pehle se kam hai to short hua bartan ya atka hua inverter/charger jo DC kheech raha hai check karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.ur: Status LED laal 9 baar - initialisation error

meaning.en: The BMS failed to initialise. The manual groups this under internal errors requiring dealer contact.
meaning.ur: BMS initialize nahi hua. Manual isay internal errors mein rakhta hai jis ke liye dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Internal fault during the BMS power-up sequence
causes.ur: BMS ke power-up sequence mein internal fault

causes.en: Distributor or battery not detected during commissioning
causes.ur: Commissioning ke dauran Distributor ya battery detect nahi hui

solutions.en: Power everything down completely and wait 3 minutes before restarting.
solutions.ur: Sab kuch mukammal band karein aur 3 minute intezaar kar ke dobara on karein.

solutions.en: Verify the battery and any Lynx Distributor connections are seated.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery aur Lynx Distributor ke connections poori tarah lage hue hain.

solutions.en: If it returns, contact your Victron supplier - the manual lists this as an internal error.
solutions.ur: Agar wapas aaye to Victron supplier se rabta karein - manual isay internal error batata hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 10x - safety contactor failure
title.ur: Status LED laal 10 baar - safety contactor failure

meaning.en: The safety contactor has failed to close or open as commanded.
meaning.ur: Safety contactor ne command ke mutabiq band ya khulna nahi kiya.

causes.en: Contactor mechanical failure or welded contacts
causes.ur: Contactor ki mechanical failure ya contacts weld ho gaye

causes.en: Contactor control wiring fault, or ATC/ATD wiring fault
causes.ur: Contactor control wiring fault, ya ATC/ATD wiring fault

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then check that all loads and chargers are actually wired to the ATC or ATD contact.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir check karein ke tamam loads aur chargers asal mein ATC ya ATD contact se jury hain.

solutions.en: Measure the contactor coil supply and the control voltage during a switching attempt.
solutions.ur: Switching ke waqt contactor coil supply aur control voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Check the contactor main contacts for continuity and pitting; replace the contactor if welded.
solutions.ur: Contactor ke main contacts ki continuity aur pitting check karein; weld ho gaye to contactor badal dein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 12x - internal supply error
title.ur: Status LED laal 12 baar - internal supply error

meaning.en: An internal supply rail has failed. The manual groups this with internal errors requiring dealer contact.
meaning.ur: Koi internal supply rail fail hua hai. Manual isay internal errors mein rakhta hai jis ke liye dealer se rabta karna hai.

causes.en: Internal supply voltage rail failure inside the BMS
causes.ur: BMS ke andar internal supply voltage rail ki failure

causes.en: Reverse polarity or severe voltage dip on the BMS supply
causes.ur: BMS supply par reverse polarity ya bohat gehri voltage dip

solutions.en: Isolate DC, then verify battery polarity and voltage at the BMS supply terminals.
solutions.ur: DC disconnect karein, phir BMS supply terminals par battery polarity aur voltage check karein.

solutions.en: Check the supply fuse and cable gauge between the battery and the BMS.
solutions.ur: Battery aur BMS ke darmiyan supply fuse aur cable gauge check karein.

solutions.en: If supply is correct, contact your Victron supplier - this is an internal error.
solutions.ur: Agar supply theek hai to Victron supplier se rabta karein - ye internal error hai.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes

title.en: Status LED red 14x - battery voltage not allowed
title.ur: Status LED laal 14 baar - battery voltage ki ijazat nahi hai

meaning.en: The battery voltage is outside every valid system voltage range. The manual states this occurs when the voltage is outside all ranges (9 V > Vbat > 60 V wording aside, the intent is outside 9-60 V).
meaning.ur: Battery voltage har mumkin system voltage range se bahar hai. Manual ke mutabiq ye tab hota hai jab voltage sab ranges se bahar ho (9 V > Vbat > 60 V lafz ke bawajood, marzi 9-60 V se bahar hai).

causes.en: Battery voltage below 9 V or above 60 V
causes.ur: Battery voltage 9 V se neeche ya 60 V se upar

causes.en: Battery settings in VictronConnect set to the wrong value
causes.ur: VictronConnect mein battery settings ghalat value par hain

solutions.en: Measure the bank voltage with a multimeter before changing any setting.
solutions.ur: Koi setting badalne se pehle multimeter se bank voltage nikaalein.

solutions.en: Compare against the manual's threshold table: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.
solutions.ur: Manual ki threshold table se compare karein: 12 V = 9-15 V, 24 V = 16-30 V, 48 V = 32-60 V.

solutions.en: Correct the battery voltage setting in VictronConnect to match the measured bank.
solutions.ur: VictronConnect mein battery voltage setting ko measured bank ke mutabiq theek karein.

source.title: Lynx Smart BMS Manual, rev 17 - 01/2026 - ch. 11.1 LED indications, warnings, alarm and error codes
